title: Importer GraphQL
description: Operations, errors, latency against REST, database, pods, versions and logs for importer-graphql. Source: importer/k8s/dashboards/importer-graphql.json

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Image tag the pods run now. Two values means a rollout is in progress.

panels.title: Ready pods
panels.description: Pods passing their readiness probe: Postgres and RabbitMQ answer.

panels.title: Operations
panels.description: GraphQL operations (queries and mutations) run in the selected time range.

panels.title: Operation errors
panels.description: Operations that returned errors: bad input (BAD_USER_INPUT), bad arguments, or internal errors. HTTP status is still 200 for these.

panels.title: Internal errors
panels.description: Operations that hit a server-side failure, e.g. the database. The GraphQL version of a 500: the error logs have the details.

panels.title: Rejected requests
panels.description: Requests refused before running: 422 (query doesn't match the schema, or over the complexity limit), 415 (not JSON or application/graphql), 405.

panels.title: p95 operation
panels.description: 95% of operations in the selected time range ran faster than this (resolvers and database, without HTTP).

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected time range (crashes, OOM kills, failed liveness probes).

panels.title: Operations per second
panels.description: By operation, named from the document (query Items { ... }). (anonymous): an unnamed operation; name them to tell them apart. _OTHER: names past the first 100 a pod has seen.

panels.title: Errors per second
panels.description: Operations that returned errors, by code: BAD_USER_INPUT (e.g. blank name), INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (logged), _OTHER (e.g. a bad id). Rejected: requests refused before running, by HTTP status.

panels.title: Operation latency
panels.description: Time to run an operation: from the parsed request to the response, so resolvers and database calls, without HTTP.

panels.title: p95 latency by operation
panels.description: Mutations write the item and its outbox event in one transaction, so they're slower than queries.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, graphql_operation_type, graphql_operation_name) (rate(graphql_server_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="importer", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Recent operations (traces)
panels.description: The last 20 operations. Open one to see the operation span (e.g. query Items) with its database calls; a createItem trace continues into importer-worker.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Item requests on each service. One GraphQL request can do the work of several REST ones (e.g. item and items together).

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: Whole HTTP requests on both sides, so the numbers compare: GraphQL adds parsing, validation and the complexity check to the same database work.

panels.title: Response size (p95)
panels.description: REST always sends every field. GraphQL sends only the fields asked for, so smaller queries mean smaller responses.

panels.title: Database call duration (p95)
panels.description: query: running SQL. acquire: waiting for a free connection. connect: opening a new connection.

panels.title: Database calls per second
panels.description: Includes the /readyz ping every 5s per pod, and the outbox relay's poll every second. Errors in red.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Connections per pod. In use near the limit (dashed) means requests wait for a connection.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per pod. Near the limit (dashed), the container is throttled and gets slower.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set per pod, what the kernel counts against the limit (dashed). Reaching it gets the container OOM-killed.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts. Check the logs around the bar, and `kubectl -n importer describe pod` for the reason (OOMKilled, liveness).

panels.title: Version history
panels.description: One row per version: colored while pods run it, the value is how many. Overlaps are rolling updates. Widen the time range to see older releases.

panels.title: Pod starts
panels.description: Every time a pod started and the version it ran (from its 'server starting' log line).

panels.title: Log lines per second
panels.description: By level. ERROR: an internal error in a resolver (database down, a panic), with the GraphQL path.

targets.expr: sum by (level) (rate({namespace="importer", container="importer-graphql", pod=~"$pod"} | json level="level" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Resolver errors, with the field path. Expand a line and use 'View trace' to open it in Tempo.

panels.title: All logs
panels.description: One line per request, with its status. Filter with the 'Search logs' box at the top, e.g. a trace id or "status":415.
